The `history` folder is `packages/engine/src/live-docs/history/`, next to `pathfind.ts`. I found 38 files in it, using the explorer's search:

- `bundled.ts` and `bundled.test.ts`
- `codec.ts`
- `derive.ts` and `derive.test.ts`
- `directories.ts` and `directories.test.ts`
- `format.ts`
- `git.ts` and `git.test.ts`
- `lens.ts` and `lens.test.ts`
- `queries.ts` and `queries.test.ts`
- `rows.ts` and `rows.test.ts`
- `sampling.ts` and `sampling.test.ts`
- `sequence.ts` and `sequence.test.ts`
- `shape.ts`
- `summary.ts` and `summary.test.ts`
- `textStore.ts` and `textStore.test.ts`
- `ticks.ts` and `ticks.test.ts`
- `versionControl.ts`
- `window.ts` and `window.test.ts`
- `words.ts` and `words.test.ts`

Of these, 23 are implementation files and 15 are tests. `codec.ts`, `format.ts`, `shape.ts` and `versionControl.ts` have no matching test file in the folder.

The explorer has no folder listing, and its search only shows about a dozen results at a time. So I searched for names starting with each letter of the alphabet to get past that limit. The explorer only lists files it has scanned, so any file it doesn't index, such as a README, wouldn't show up here.

Nothing was copied to the clipboard.
